title.zh: ⚡️ZachXBT质疑CoinDCX：1580万美元用户存款去向不明
title.en: ⚡️ZachXBT质疑CoinDCX：1580万美元用户存款去向不明

current_state.zh: ZachXBT alleged that about $15.8 million in CoinDCX user deposits remains unaccounted for and that a deposit address linked to a 2025 security incident continued collecting user funds and routing them to CoinDCX's current hot wallet, claims CoinDCX disputes.
